caption: The drawing depicts a pair of long fire tongs with a decorative, spindle-shaped handle colored in muted shades of brass or bronze at the top left. The tongs themselves are shown in brown and metallic tones, reflecting a combination of wood or iron construction. The two rounded arms of the tongs join at a central pivot point, which is detailed in a metallic color, and then extend straight before curving at the ends to form the gripping section. There are two inset images within the main rectangular border of the drawing: the upper right inset provides a close-up view of the pivot and handle joint, while the lower left inset presents a detailed view of the gripping ends when closed. Both insets are bordered with thin lines. The drawing is labeled “Fire Tongs Scale 1" = 3"” at the bottom, along with the name “Clyde L. Cheney.” The overall color scheme uses primarily subdued browns, grays, and metallic hues, all drawn on a plain off-white background.
title: Fire Tongs
